uncertain: Insaraum vs Insalaum (not in my brief, affects Arksaber prose): akurasu prose uses 'Insalaum' ~150 times, but the saved glossary (precedence 2), Z3.2 D-Trader and the Jigoku glossary say 'Insaraum'; original_1c already uses Insaraum. Keep one.

Kind: people whose glossary row comes from a library keyword card are kept as kind keyword per the keep-the-kind rule (アンナロッタ, アンブローン, アンブローン・ジウス, シュラン). They are persons; the Jigoku glossary lists Annalotta as pilot.

アンブローン / アンブローン・ジウス: I settled 'Anbrorn' / 'Anbrorn Jeus' (akurasu Z2.2 Story2-6 and the character list) over the Jigoku glossary proposal 'Ambrone Zius' (status proposed). Unusual but the only wiki-backed form.

オーティス vs オーディス: the library uses both for Esther's destroyed hometown (keyword 120 vs pilot 499). Wiki gives 'Otis' (Z3.2 Flow Chart, 'Siege of the Otis Base') and 'Ordis' (Z2 Story Summary Part 1; ja.wikipedia オーディス). I kept each spelling as is; the orchestrator may prefer to unify (for example retoken $$オーティス$$ in keyword 120 to $$オーディス$$).

Conflicting akurasu spellings decided by precedence: Cravia (glossary) vs Kravia (Z3.R summary, 58 uses) vs Clavia/Clavier; Sardias (Z3.R) vs Saldias (character list); Girtar (Z3.R, 72 uses) vs Gilter (character list); Cheval (character list + Z2 Story page) vs Shubal (Z2 summary); Reptail vs Repter; Roddick vs Laudic/Rhodic; Crowe Bluste (Z3.2 pilot DB) vs Bluest/Bruste/Broust. Girtar Belone and Sardias Ax combine a Z3.R given name with the character-list surname.

ガナリー・カーバー: I used 'Gunnery Carver' (Z3.R summary in the same context); the saved glossary says the Sorrowful Maiden Sphere sits in a 'Nautilus Carver' (Virgola Glory main weapon), which ja.wikipedia places in the ガナリー・カーバー, so glossary and prose probably name the same weapon and the glossary (precedence 2) would then win.

クロノエイチ: rendered 'Black Wisdom' to match 黒の英知 (original_1c) since the library says the same person 'touched' it; the ja.wikipedia code name is Latin 'CHRONO H', so 'Chrono H' is the alternative if the pun should survive.
サクリファイ = 'Sacrifice' rests on the akurasu page title 'Sadness Sacrifice'; the katakana ends in -fai (proposals said 'Sacrifai').
ガイアエンパイア: kw_000 claimed the Z3.R Story Summary says 'Gaia Empire'; the saved page has no such string, so 'Gaia Empire' is only a literal romanization.

AG (pilot 488): the library says AG abbreviates AGENT, ja.wikipedia says 'All Gathered'; profile gender is 'not applicable', although its personality core is the male Jie Babel. Translators should avoid he/she for AG.
Shinya Ohara (pilot 527): no source states gender; left 'unknown', not inferred from the name.
Xenity (pilot 503 profile): akurasu Z2 summary writes 'Zenitory' (10 uses, uses 'he'), the character list and Jigoku glossary 'Xenity Masse'; the name belongs to original_1c but the two forms differ.
Jerald (pilot 533): original_1b uses 'Geraud', akurasu Z2.2 summaries use 'Gerard' 60 times.
Leben (original_1c): the Z1 pilot database on akurasu names the Chimera 1st Squad captain 'Löwen General'; the character list says 'Leben General'.
The character list page names Shikoku's page 'Engraving' (尸刻); the reading is しこく per ja.wikipedia (original_1c settled 'Shikoku').

Shared names checked against original_1b/1c output: Marguerite Pistail, Pistail, Straus, Barbiel, Uther Insaraum, Ziene, Lotta, Black Wisdom, New Earth Empire, Vildark, The Edel Bernal are consistent with mine; no disagreement found.
ja.wikipedia (バンプレストオリジナルのキャラクター一覧, カイメラ, グローリー・スター) is a supplementary source used for gender, position and personality; it gives no English spellings.

Proposed only (no source for the English): ご家族の事故, アクエリア市, アムブリエル (Gemini angel, Wikipedia), アンナ, エグゼクター, エス・テラン, エタニティ・フラット, オカルトフォーラム, カオス・コスモス, カオス・レムレース, ガイアエンパイア, ガン・アーレス, キング, クィーン, クロノエイチ, サフィーアダ, シェーヌ.
